title: [DOM] Numeric hyphenateLimitLines gets px appended, so the browser drops the declaration
author: swastiktawate
body_preview: `hyphenate-limit-lines` takes a bare integer (or `no-limit`), but React treats a numeric value as a length and appends `px`. The browser then drops the declaration as invalid, so the style silently never applies.
